message:
I will apply Sam's six notes from `notes.md` to the Northside Physio prototype and run to the end without asking again.

**Found:**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only one in the folder, plain HTML with 4 screens (Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings). I will serve it locally.
- Notes: `notes.md`, 6 notes from Sam, no reference to copy.
- No `CLAUDE.md` and no design skills found, so I use the built-in design checks.
- Browser for screenshots and Node 25.9 both work.
- Nothing will be published, pushed or committed. The result is a local link.

**Track:** full. There is no reference, so quick and full are the same.

**Coverage:** 6 clear · partial: Edge cases, Look · missing: none

**Done means:**
- All 7 rows below are done, or left with a reason.
- "Customers" appears nowhere on any screen or in the code.
- Before and after screenshots show no screen changed by accident.
- Every changed part of the code traces to a row.
- The prototype's link answers 200.

**Your notes as I read them** (full list with checks in `brief.md`):
- R1 Today: "New appointment" opens a form with client, time, therapist, type
- R2 Today: Save adds the appointment to the list in time order, Cancel closes it (my reading)
- R3 Clients: rename "Customers" to "Clients" everywhere
- R4 Settings: replace the latin under Booking policy with a short 24 hour cancellation policy
- R5 Invoices: more room in rows, 12px top and bottom (my reading)
- R6 Invoices: the "Overdue" filter says "No overdue invoices." instead of a blank table
- R7 Today: the date in the heading is 14px and muted, the title stays 22px (my reading)

Anything missing or wrong? Notes you send later still join this run.

About 40 minutes and 2 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

1. Should Save on the new appointment form add the appointment to Today's list?
   Recommended: yes, in time order, with Room shown as "Unassigned". It is sample data and resets on reload.
   Why it matters: the other option, a form that only closes, makes the button look like it works when it does not.

2. What should the Booking policy say?
   Recommended: "Appointments can be cancelled or moved free of charge up to 24 hours before they start. Later changes may be charged the full session fee."
   Why it matters: the fee sentence is my addition, and a real clinic policy is yours to decide.

3. Should the roomier rows apply to the Invoices table only, or to every table?
   Recommended: Invoices only, as your note says. Today and Clients tables use the same tight spacing and stay as they are.
   Why it matters: "every table" changes two screens you did not name.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
